audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill on rows 0-3 and 5; content and packet both read Hwei L1-4/5 and Malzahar at first item. Layers disagree on five of seven rows.
audit.why: Content whys are grounded (QQ/QE outrange pre-6, point-and-click R flip at 6, Liandry's kill window); full whys are the generic template; 49.26% WR fits a lose-early-win-6 curve.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content/packet: Hwei rows 0-3, Malzahar rows 4-5, Skill row 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike structure is right (Hwei Lvl 3-5, Malz at 6 and first item, even late) but spikes[1] names 'EE (Crushing Maelstrom)' and 'ER (Stirring Lands)' — the real casts are EE Crushing Maw, EQ Grim Visage, and WE Stirring Lights; spikes[3] writes 'W (Fleeting Currents)' for WQ Fleeting Current.
audit.why: Riot's palette lists: E = Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw; W = Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, Stirring Lights.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer tracks a fabricated 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — Hwei's E is Subject: Torment. Missing: his EQ fear / EW root break Nether Grasp mid-channel, and his W-palette shield (18s) absorbs the burst window. cooldowns field has no digit.
audit.why: Packet defect notes no real Hwei ability is ever named; missing-interactions file lists both interactions; Malz R is channel-interruptible per his own kit.
audit.corrected: Subject: Torment (E, 12s rank 1) named everywhere; suppress only after the E palette is spent; force the W shield before committing.
